project.name: STRYT
project.description: Hyperlocal marketplace and community PWA connecting neighbors with local businesses and service providers
project.architecture: Mobile-first PWA, multi-tenant tri-hat context model, Supabase-backed React SPA

conventions.strict_mode: noUnusedLocals enabled in tsconfig (unused imports fail build)

state_synchronization.context_state: activeContext: { type: 'customer'|'business'|'provider', id: string|null, name?: string }
state_synchronization.critical_race_condition: addRole() in store.tsx:626 must be awaited before refreshUser(). If un-awaited, refreshUser() reads stale DB state and resets roles to ['customer'].

security_and_pii_masking.description: Supabase RLS masks private user columns from standard select queries. Raw select('phone, lat, lng') returns null or throws RLS error.

security_definer_rpcs.name: get_own_profile()
security_definer_rpcs.purpose: Full unmasked user row for auth.uid()

security_definer_rpcs.name: aliases_available(p_aliases text[])
security_definer_rpcs.purpose: Case-insensitive check for free @handles excluding caller's row

security_definer_rpcs.name: record_terms_acceptance(p_version text, p_user_agent text)
security_definer_rpcs.purpose: Appends audit log and stamps users.terms_accepted_version

beats.purpose: Confirm display name, avatar, and select language (en/hi/mr)
Pick or type @alias, verified via aliases_available RPC
Acquire GPS or search locality via forwardGeocode, save lat/lng/area
Select top-level category interest IDs to seed Home feed ranking

known_blockers: Google OAuth seeds real name, causing isUnusableName to return false and skipping Beat 0 and Language Switcher on first login
Search in BeatLocation is not debounced, triggering 429 Too Many Requests from Nominatim
ob_beat localStorage key is global and bleeds between accounts on same device
Phone input maxLength=10 truncates +91 numbers to 9 digits before non-digit regex strip
Operating hours are coupled to bookings toggle, setting hours: null for retail/dining when bookings disabled
Uploaded photo thumbnails have no delete/trash button, preventing removal of mistaken uploads
Triggers trg_enforce_business_owner_limit if user owns 5 businesses, rejecting submit with no preflight check
Phone number input is completely missing; providers.phone is null, breaking public 'Call' button on ProviderDetail
Proposing new category sets cat=null, saving categoryId=null and categoryName=null in database
Portfolio upload failure leaves provider row inserted, bricking retries via idx_providers_one_per_user
CommunityPostDetail is missing the '+ Recommend' button present on feed cards
Comment composer lacks 'Attach place/provider' button even though schema and service support listing_type and listing_id
CommentRow has no Delete button for author or post owner
Bookmarks.tsx has no 'Community' / 'Posts' tab to view saved posts

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Customer cannot call service provider from ProviderDetail screen
trace: ProviderDetail.tsx:184, 570 checks 'p.phone && p.showPhonePublicly !== false'
providers.phone in DB is NULL
providerService.create() did not receive phone
ProviderOnboard.tsx lacks phone state and input
troubleshooting_rules.root_cause: Provider onboarding flow never collects or passes the provider's phone number.
troubleshooting_rules.fix_action: Add phone state and input in Step 1/3, pre-fill from user.phone, and pass to providerService.create().

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: User loses business_owner or provider role after page refresh or reload
trace: BusinessOnboard.tsx / ProviderOnboard.tsx calls addRole('role')
store.tsx:626 executes 'void userService.update({ roles: next })' (un-awaited fire-and-forget)
refreshUser() runs immediately in parallel, querying get_own_profile before DB update commits
refreshUser() overwrites optimistic roles with stale DB roles ['customer']
troubleshooting_rules.root_cause: Race condition caused by fire-and-forget userService.update in addRole().
troubleshooting_rules.fix_action: Make addRole async or await userService.update() before refreshUser() runs.

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Phone input blocks user with validation error when pasting +91 or 0 prefix
trace: BusinessOnboard.tsx:196 has input with maxLength={10}
User types or pastes '+919876543210' (13 chars)
HTML input truncates to '+919876543' (10 chars)
onChange regex replace(/\D/g, '') strips '+' leaving '919876543' (9 digits)
canNext validation requires length === 10, failing permanently
troubleshooting_rules.root_cause: maxLength={10} is enforced before non-digit characters and country code are stripped.
troubleshooting_rules.fix_action: Remove raw maxLength or strip leading +91/91/0 in onChange before slicing to 10 digits.

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Store operating hours disappear on BusinessDetail for retail or dining shops
trace: BusinessOnboard.tsx:219 renders WeeklyHoursEditor only '{wantsBookings && ...}'
BusinessOnboard.tsx:128 submits 'hours: wantsBookings ? (hoursRaw || undefined) : undefined'
Retail/dining shops toggle off bookings, sending hours: undefined (NULL in Postgres)
BusinessDetail.tsx cannot render working hours or evaluate store open status
troubleshooting_rules.root_cause: Store operating hours are wrongly coupled to appointment booking availability.
troubleshooting_rules.fix_action: Always display WeeklyHoursEditor and submit hoursRaw regardless of wantsBookings.

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Retrying provider onboarding crashes with 'You already have a provider profile'
trace: ProviderOnboard.tsx:71 submit() calls providerService.create() before photo uploads
providerService.create() successfully inserts row in providers table
Promise.all(photos.map(uploadService.upload)) fails due to network or image size
submit() throws to catch block
User clicks Submit profile again
providerService.create() hits Postgres unique index idx_providers_one_per_user
troubleshooting_rules.root_cause: Non-atomic submission: DB row is created before storage uploads complete.
troubleshooting_rules.fix_action: Upload portfolio assets before creating provider row, or handle partial upload failure non-fatally.

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Proposing a custom category in ProviderOnboard creates a listing with NULL category
trace: User types in 'newCat', ProviderOnboard.tsx:183 sets 'cat = null'
ProviderOnboard.tsx:86 submits 'categoryId: cat ?? undefined'
selectedCat is undefined, submitting 'categoryName: undefined'
providers row is saved with category_id = NULL and category_name = NULL
troubleshooting_rules.root_cause: Custom category name from newCat is not passed into providerService.create().
troubleshooting_rules.fix_action: Pass categoryName: newCat.trim() to providerService.create() when newCat is present.

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Location search dropdown blanks out while user types in BeatLocation
trace: BeatLocation.tsx:156 onChange calls search(e.target.value) on every keystroke
search() immediately invokes forwardGeocode() without debounce
OpenStreetMap Nominatim enforces 1 req/sec rate limit
Rapid typing triggers HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
catch block executes setResults([]), wiping dropdown
troubleshooting_rules.fix_action: Add 400ms setTimeout debounce with sequence ref before calling forwardGeocode().

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Brand-new Google user never sees Language Switcher (Hindi/Marathi) on signup
trace: User signs up via Google OAuth, userService.me() populates user.name
UserOnboard.tsx:52 evaluates isUnusableName(user.name) as false
UserOnboard.tsx:53 hits 'if (!user.alias) return 1'
Beat 0 (BeatIdentity.tsx) is bypassed entirely on first login
Language switcher on Beat 0 is never rendered
troubleshooting_rules.root_cause: Initial beat logic skips Beat 0 if user.name is valid rather than checking if onboarding was completed.
troubleshooting_rules.fix_action: Base initial beat on scoped localStorage check ob_beat_${user.id} instead of isUnusableName.

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Uploaded photos cannot be deleted or replaced in Business/Provider onboarding
trace: BusinessOnboard.tsx:80-84 renders thumbnails with no action overlays
ProviderOnboard.tsx:244-250 renders thumbnails with no action overlays
User selects incorrect photo from camera/gallery
No delete/X/trash button exists in component DOM
troubleshooting_rules.root_cause: Missing photo removal affordance in UI thumbnail loop.
troubleshooting_rules.fix_action: Wrap thumbnail in relative div with absolute close button calling setPhotos(prev => prev.filter(...)) and URL.revokeObjectURL().

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Direct select of phone or lat/lng returns null or throws RLS permission error
trace: Developer writes sb.from('users').select('phone, lat, lng').eq('id', uid)
PostgreSQL RLS policy or view masks sensitive columns (ISS-009)
troubleshooting_rules.root_cause: Sensitive personal data columns are protected and not selectable via standard table queries.
troubleshooting_rules.fix_action: Call sb.rpc('get_own_profile') for full profile or sb.rpc('get_own_coords') for coordinates.
